periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the sagittal plane of the face, sloping towards the lower mandible.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a visible length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the ventral-posterior margin, shifting the geometric center upwards relative to the lowest visible point of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior profile with a wide, flat transition across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is substantial, covering approximately 30% of the visible dorsal-lateral torso height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive region of thinning fur and brownish-red discoloration/staining on the posterior-lateral flank and lower dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Inverted head position relative to the torso axis; exposure of the oral cavity, including teeth and tongue, due to open-mouth posture.
